text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"Clear position in introduction and conclusion","quality":"stance clarity","description":"The essay states its claim early and returns to it at the end so the reader never loses track of the writer’s position."},{"evidence":"Article-based benefits and counterpoints throughout","quality":"use of evidence","description":"The essay draws more consistently on details from the source article to support both its reasons and its rebuttal of concerns."},{"evidence":"Paragraph on flaws and solutions","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"The essay acknowledges objections and responds to them instead of only repeating its own side."},{"evidence":"Explains liability with driver vs. manufacturer","quality":"reasoned analysis","description":"The essay goes beyond quoting the article by working through how one of the central problems could be resolved."},{"evidence":"Smooth transitions between benefit, concern, and conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is arranged in a more logical argumentative flow that moves from claim to support to response to wrap-up."}]}
